title: Group Fitness Class Passes: guest booking, household sharing, credit transfer and gift transferability by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. For each class-credit pack tier, it states whether a guest may be booked into a class using the member's credit and the fee for doing so, whether a household add-on dependent may redeem the pack's credits, the fee to transfer credits to another member, and whether unused credits may be gifted (transferred) to another member at all.

## Basis by tier
Each tier fixes whether a guest booking is permitted and, where permitted, the extra fee charged for it. Each tier separately fixes whether a household add-on dependent may redeem credits from the pack. Each tier also fixes whether unused credits are gift-transferable to another member and, where transfer is permitted, the fee charged for the transfer.

| Tier | Guest booking allowed | Guest fee (USD) | Family sharing allowed | Gift transferable | Transfer fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5-Class Pack | No | 0 | No | No | 0 |
| 10-Class Pack | Yes | 15.00 | No | Yes | 15.00 |
| 20-Class Pack | Yes | 15.00 | No | Yes | 15.00 |
| Unlimited Monthly Classes | No | 0 | No | No | 0 |
| Specialty Studio Pack | Yes | 25.00 | No | No | 20.00 |
| Founding Class Pass | Yes | 10.00 | Yes | Yes | 0 |

## Points of judgement
- The Founding Class Pass is the only tier that permits household add-on dependents to redeem its credits, and the only tier that permits gift transfer at no transfer fee.
- The Specialty Studio Pack sets a nonzero transfer fee (20.00) despite not permitting a gift transfer at all — that fee has no application under this tier's gift-transferability setting.
- The 5-Class Pack and Unlimited Monthly Classes tiers permit neither guest booking nor gift transfer.
